notes: Suggested follow-up tasks no longer pile up on their own — open a card and add just the ones you want with [+ Add to TO-DO].
You can delete tasks now — hit the ✕ in the task list on the left and it's gone.
Your Office level and activity grid no longer go backwards — old logs may get cleaned up, but what you've earned stays.
Fixed: with multiple accounts, everything done on the other accounts was missing — level, activity grid, usage, rankings and Sessions search now count it all.
Fixed: Sessions search only looked at the start of long conversations — it now searches the whole thing, and it got faster too.
Also fixed: a card that only ran a slash (/) command did nothing yet was marked “Done”, and the sign-in screen showed no version — you can now grab a new version before signing in.
